answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, quill and haven mechanisms establish Sybil resistance. Agents must stake quills, and for each Sybil attempt, a proportional haven is deducted, incurring substantial costs. This economic model ensures attackers bear higher expected losses, preventing Sybil creation. Dawn mechanisms, through verifiable delay functions, further secure attestations, sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance. Thus, the protocol robustly resists Sybil attacks by balancing economic incentives and cryptographic security.
